_about: The kit's bundled sound effects: bought from ElevenLabs text-to-sound (eleven_text_to_sound_v2) on a paid plan for the first two explainers (Sep 30 and Oct 1, 2026) and given away with the kit, free to use with no credit (CC0, see LICENSE.md). Measured: secs, attack (where it first reaches half its peak), peak, sounding range, rms_db while sounding, peak_dbfs. 'trim' = play only that part. 'level' = a starting level in dB under the voice, from the approved mixes.

whoosh1.prompt: soft airy cinematic whoosh transition, smooth air movement, clean, no impact, no music

whoosh2.prompt: gentle smooth whoosh pass by, soft air, subtle cinematic transition, clean, no music

swish1.prompt: fast soft swish, quick whip pan air swipe, clean, subtle

swish2.prompt: quick soft air swipe swoosh, short, clean, subtle

land1.prompt: soft deep muted thud, gentle low UI impact as a number appears on screen, clean, minimal, no reverb tail

land2.prompt: soft low felt thump, subtle interface hit, warm, short, clean

tick1.use: an item, a layer, a stop
tick1.prompt: single soft UI click tick, subtle clean digital interface sound

tick2.prompt: tiny soft wooden click, subtle, clean, single

pop.prompt: soft gentle bubble pop, UI notification, subtle, single

counter.prompt: rapid soft digital counter ticking, fast tiny ticks speeding up, subtle, clean

click.prompt: single computer mouse click, crisp, close, clean
click.note: the 'single click' came back as three: trim keeps the first

powerup.prompt: soft electric power up shimmer, gentle rising hum of lights turning on, subtle, clean

shimmer.use: a field of things filling in
shimmer.prompt: delicate digital shimmer swell, many tiny sparkling ticks, airy, soft, subtle

paper.prompt: paper card sliding onto a table, soft swoosh, close, clean

receipt.use: a receipt printing (trim to a burst)
receipt.prompt: thermal receipt printer printing a receipt, fast mechanical whirring chatter, close, clean
